fixtureGoal: Capture where Java release evidence should be retained for later audit review without executing deployment, rollback, SQL, or reading secret values.

auditExportFields.name: retention-id
auditExportFields.description: Operator records the retention record identifier used by the release evidence archive.

auditExportFields.name: release-operator
auditExportFields.description: Operator records who owns this retained release evidence.

auditExportFields.name: artifact-target
auditExportFields.description: Operator records the release tag or artifact version covered by this retention record.

auditExportFields.name: retention-days
auditExportFields.description: Operator records how long this evidence should remain available for audit review.

auditExportFields.name: evidence-endpoints
auditExportFields.description: Operator confirms which Java read-only evidence endpoints are retained.

auditExportFields.name: audit-export-location-placeholder
auditExportFields.description: Operator records where exported audit evidence will be stored outside this fixture.

auditExportFields.name: no-secret-value-boundary
auditExportFields.description: Operator confirms retained evidence stores metadata only and never embeds secret values.

noSecretValueBoundaries: Secret values must not be read by Java or Node when rendering this retention record
Secret values must not be embedded in retained audit evidence
Node may render the cross-project retention gate only
forbiddenOperations: Executing Java deployment from this fixture
Executing Java rollback from this fixture
Executing database rollback SQL from this fixture
Writing audit export files from Node through this fixture
Connecting production database from this fixture
Reading production secret values from this fixture
Embedding secret values in retained audit evidence
